gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states a named reviewer's battery measurement for the Lofree Flow Lite84: Notebookcheck estimated about 100 hours on Bluetooth with the backlight off, about 16.6 hours on Bluetooth at maximum backlight, and about 10 hours on 2.4 GHz at maximum backlight.
standout_why: Compared against pcreviewer.org (cited) and kbdcompare.com (cited), both opened 2026-11-21. pcreviewer.org gives the Flow Lite as 'about 80 hours, lights off' with no source and attributes no measurement to a named reviewer; its one backlight-on figure (Keychron K3 Pro, about 68 hours) is the author's own calculation. kbdcompare.com says of itself that it 'is not a lab benchmark' and carries only maker or listed specs. Limits: technobezz.com (cited, HTTP 403) and purchase.fyi (cited, TLS certificate error) could not be opened, and the RTINGS list returned only its navigation shell, so I cannot rule out that one of those three has it. The side-by-side is also thin: hours by connection and backlight exist for one candidate (Flow Lite84), a looser per-day figure for a second (Akko Air 01), and nothing from a named reviewer for the rest.
decides: It confirms the Lofree Flow Lite84 as an in-budget typing pick but adds a condition, and it does not decide between candidates because no other board has a matching measurement. Notebookcheck's backlight-off estimate (about 100 hours on Bluetooth) is in line with a multi-day battery, but with the backlight at maximum the same board lasted an estimated 16.6 hours on Bluetooth and 10 hours on the 2.4 GHz dongle, so a shopper who keeps the lights on over the dongle charges it roughly daily. The measurement is on the original Flow Lite84 (Specter linear, 2,000 mAh), which the brief's partner table lists at $99.00 on the page and $79.20 at checkout on 2026-11-21. It must not be carried over to the Flow Lite 2 84 we already list, which is a different board. Notebookcheck also reports wake-and-reconnect delays of up to five seconds on Bluetooth and keycap shine after about 40 hours, both worth one line as named drawbacks.
